checks: strict history window includes exact t-720 row and meets 24-row/3-date boundary
current-hour row is excluded at t and enters history at t+1 while the exact 720-hour boundary rolls out
six same-code histories qualify at common t, including peers without a current row; peer rarity is equally vessel-weighted
synthetic fixture yields distinct B0/S/G winners: later highest legacy baseline, S legacy tie, and G peer-only self tie-break
all methods share cap=min(4,G actual pool n), with exact B0/S/G masks
empty S/G uses documented fallback; B0/S/G legacy-only paths rank descending as [.9,.5,.1]
invalid base defers, observed-small rejects, and missing geometry defers without violating mask hierarchy
appending a future row leaves every existing score and stage unchanged
duplicate RFID/hour and fractional source-clock hours are rejected
